transformation: Target text retained after source pseudonymization. Examples omit unrelated context only for these selected targets whose labels are established by their own text; actual evaluated chat context is never dropped.
review: Two blinded high-confidence AI reviews agree on selected categories. Not human-verified. No heldout examples or old model predictions.
category_note: Stylized generic viewer-service pitch is illustrated in ads; spam examples use the explicit AI-viewer offer to avoid broadening spam to every generic advertisement.
public_redaction: Individual source IDs omitted; full mapping retained only in protected local example manifest.
